reason: The README clearly describes a read-only adversarial multi-perspective code review plugin with static scanning, model-assisted findings, severity grading, history, reports, a dsh tool, and a standalone CLI.

summaries.zh: 用于对代码变更或指定文件执行多视角审查，结合静态规则与模型分析生成带严重度、证据和修复建议的报告。
summaries.en: Performs multi-perspective reviews of code changes or selected files using deterministic rules and model-assisted analysis to produce reports with severity, evidence, and fix suggestions.

capabilities: Reads unified diffs or specified files for code review
Performs deterministic static rule scanning and model-assisted review
Calls a configured model service through an API
Writes review reports, history records, and suppression rules
Registers a gavel_review tool in dsh and provides a standalone CLI
